- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Step 0 (lines 9-18); Zombie-checker cleanup section (lines 184-194) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trigger's placement and wording can lead an unattended session to run issue-mode cleanup before Step 1 has read the plan and made the `Source issue:` identifier available.
  WHY: Cleanup can be skipped or have no issue identifier to query, leaving stopped sessions unarchived; severity disagreement: Google Gemini rated this BLOCKER and MiniMax rated it NIT.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Zombie-checker cleanup logic (lines 184-194); Issue mode: stopped stage sessions bullet around line 190 (and byte-identical twin workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A transient `mcp__github__issue_read get_labels` failure has no retry within the same resume, so the stopped session remains unarchived until another resume or manual archival.
  WHY: The cleanup fails closed and runs once per resume; severity disagreement: Google Gemini rated the failure handling MAJOR and MiniMax rated it NIT.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Zombie-checker cleanup logic (lines 184-194) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup does not document robust failure handling for a transient `set_session_title` failure.
  WHY: A rename failure can leave the session with its old title, which cleanup will not match, requiring manual operator intervention.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Stops bullet around line 107 — rename-failure fallback clause (and byte-identical twin) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The rename-failure fallback does not document what happens if the blocker-comment edit also fails after the rename retry fails.
  WHY: The session ID then appears only in the session's chat report, which may scroll out of operator view, and neither the old title nor the issue comment provides a discovery path.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Step 1 trailing sentence ("**Issue-mode resume cleanup:** ... run the Zombie-checker cleanup now, right after this read and before step 2.") and the Issue Mode → Stops bullet ("the next session removes the label, resumes from the log, and archives the stopped session in its Zombie-checker cleanup"). | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: No numbered step orders removal of `ai:claude-blocked` before the Step 1 cleanup checks whether the source issue still has that label.
  WHY: The cleanup finds the label still present and keeps the stopped session, so it is not archived on that resume.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  EVIDENCE: The header sentence "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up" remains unchanged, contradicting the deferral described in the Step 0 bullet and misdirecting unattended sessions.
- requirement: When Step 1 reads a plan that lacks a `Source issue:` header line, the issue-mode cleanup must either log/report the skip or be documented as an intentional no-op so an operator can distinguish a project-mode resume from cleanup that was silently dropped.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` (and twin), Step 0 bullet and cleanup section.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The new bullet at line 12 says "a plan without that line skips this" but never instructs the session to log/report the skip. The cleanup-section report line at line 192 only fires when `m` is computable, so a project-mode resume with no `Source issue:` line never produces a count or log.

- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and byte-identical twin workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md): Stops bullet around line 107 — "if the rename fails, retry it once; if it still fails, end the blocker comment with `Stopped session: <session id> (rename failed; archive it by hand after the resume)`" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Stops bullet documents retry-once for rename failure and a fallback to the blocker comment, but does not document what happens if the blocker-comment edit itself also fails after the rename retry failure (triple-failure case: rename fails twice AND comment edit fails).
  WHY: An unattended session with a transient rename failure AND a transient comment-edit failure loses the discovery path entirely; the cleanup will not match the session because its title was never renamed, and the issue comment does not name it.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and byte-identical twin workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md): Zombie-checker cleanup "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions." bullet around line 190 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label-read failure path is documented as fail-closed with no retry within the same resume. A transient MCP/network failure on the `mcp__github__issue_read get_labels` call leaves the stopped session unarchived for the entire resume attempt; the next resume is the only recovery.
  WHY: The cleanup runs once per resume; if the MCP call transiently fails, the stopped `— blocked on issue` session sits idle until the next `/reclarify` resume or manual archival.
